title: Tet10 element (10-node quadratic tetrahedron, 4-point quadrature)
objective: Add the Tet10 quadratic tetrahedron: 10 nodes (4 corners + 6 edge midpoints), quadratic shape functions, 4-point Gauss quadrature.
scope: Add the 10 quadratic shape functions in terms of volume coordinates.
Add the 4-point Gauss quadrature rule (standard symmetric rule).
implementation_steps: Derive the 10 shape functions from the quadratic interpolation formula on tetrahedra.
Enumerate the 4-point Gauss quadrature weights and barycentric coordinates.
Unit-test partition of unity, quadratic-field exactness, positive Jacobian.
Cross-check the quadrature rule by integrating a quadratic polynomial whose exact integral is known.
acceptance_criteria: Partition of unity at all 4 quadrature points.
Quadratic field exactness (reproduces a x + b y + c z + d + e x^2 + ... to machine precision).
Polynomial-integration test against a known exact value.
risks: The 4-point quadrature rule has specific barycentric coordinates; transcription errors give subtle accuracy bugs. Mitigation: cross-check against a published reference like Hughes or Zienkiewicz.
completion_notes: Added ElementType.TET10 + tet10 basis/quadrature + tet10_tables.py (Keast/Zienkiewicz 4-point symmetric rule).
Widened ElementIR/ProblemIR supported sets to {hex8, tet4, tet10}; Hex20+ still rejected with Plan B phase B5 pointer.
Quadrature integrates L_a*L_b and L_a^2 to machine precision (3.5e-18 error).
Full fast suite: 1171 passed + 27 skipped + 1 expected TODO fail.
